tools.name: find_pros
tools.description: List the businesses in the Flathead Trades directory for a kind of work, optionally in one town, with phone numbers, websites and a link to each listing. Covers Whitefish, Columbia Falls, Evergreen, Kalispell, Somers, Bigfork, Lakeside and Polson, Montana.

tools.name: list_trades_and_towns
tools.description: The trades and towns the Flathead Trades directory covers, with how many businesses each has.

tools.name: start_quote
tools.description: Make a link that opens the Flathead Trades quote form already filled with the work, the town and the description. The person finishes it and agrees to be contacted themselves; the request then goes to one local pro who is taking new work. Free for homeowners.
